summary: ProPetro Holding Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $690M aggregate principal amount of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031, including the full exercise of the initial purchasers' option for an additional $90M. The notes are senior unsecured obligations maturing November 15, 2031, with an initial conversion rate of 43.1616 shares per $1,000 principal (conversion price ~$23.17 per share, a ~37.5% premium over the $16.85 closing price on May 4, 2026). The company may settle conversions in cash, stock, or a combination. Notes are redeemable at par on or after May 15, 2029. This convertible offering serves as a capital return mechanism; watch for dilution management and potential share repurchases with proceeds.
